answer: Each identity draws work from a serialized batch: one data or compute lot its supplier signs and issues once. The registry binds that serial to one claiming key, and two keys offering one serial cancel each other instead of doubling weight. A farm cannot spin a thousand wallets from one input; it must buy a thousand distinct lots from suppliers fined for reselling duplicates. A juniper grove and a bare dune look alike from orbit; only one has roots. Clones alike: identical until each must show a different receipt, a crystal that cannot be cut twice. Weight follows provenance, not headcount.
